'''Wheat''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] product grown in fields.<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> A variant of it, [[Dry Gene Wheat]], was used in [[Skannbult Likker]], along with [[Dust-Corn]].
